Rah-e-Safar: Meaning & Why I Chose It

The meaning: Rah-e-Safar combines two words from Urdu and Persian. Rah means "path" and Safar means "journey". Together they mean "The path of the journey."

Rah-e-Safar is more than a name; it is a promise to turn every journey into an unforgettable story.

We believe every dream deserves a journey. Our aim is to turn travel dreams into reality through the natural beauty, adventure, recreation and rich culture of Swat.

Rah-e-Safar — Where Every Path Becomes a Memory.
